lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Don't stand around, Junior Encoder. Remember what we discussed.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: The draft letter is missing the official Student Council tracking code. Go find Leila in the classroom—she manages the budget logs.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Get that code from her first so we can finalize the request.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Right on it, Ma'am. Let's find Leila.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Make sure that letter is properly formatted with the tracking code.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Exquisite. The bold subject line gives it immediate urgency, and the designations look authoritative.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Mr. Reyes won't be able to ignore this. Excellent work, Junior Encoder.
